summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Daleel Pets code quality refactor. Backend achieved 97.9% success rate (46/47 tests). Frontend testing confirmed all major functionality working including login, navigation, KPI loading, store registry with 8 stores, Zarafa Tier 2 crawling, digest modal, and bilingual Arabic/English support.

design_issues.note: Expected behavior when modal is open
